newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains higher, but trade slow.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains higher, but trade slow.

text.p: UK cash grain prices were mostly higher on Monday, but sellers were mostly withdrawn.
"There are a few odd trades being done, but there are no markets," said one broker.
This view was backed up by others who added that what few sellers there had been in the market had withdrawn as the futures rose.

"People are square at the moment but the market is split 50-50 as to whether it will go up or down. What ever happens the business will be there for the taking from April through to July," said another broker.
No trading was reported on the fob market where buyers and sellers were around one stg apart.
Delivered material was trading around one stg above Friday's levels, but broker said there was not much volume behind the business.
